newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres debt paper gets CIB Aa rating.
newsitem.headline: Benpres debt paper gets CIB Aa rating.

text.p: Benpres Holdings Corp said on Thursday Philippine rating body Credit Information Bureau Inc gave an above average rating of CIB Aa to its three-billion peso long term commercial paper issue.
The Philippine holding firm furnished a copy of the CIBI rating to the Securities and Exchange Commission as it started selling debt securities to the public from Thursday.
Benpres said in a statement the rating indicates that it has adequate cash flow up to year 2007 to pay its debt.
The rating also indicates the firm's capability to tap alternative financing options, minimal exposure to debt and the attainability of its projected earnings, Benpres said.
Benpres vice president Rafael Andrada said the papers are being offered in two tranches, with five and seven year maturities.
"We are confident there is market acceptability for the issue considering the solid track record Benpres has demonstrated as well as its subsidiaries," Andrada said.
Benpres said it plans to use proceeds of the issue to finance expansion of its telecommunications, construction and property development businesses.
